Meat too!!! Meat too!!!!

rows.label: tlk70000058_04_msg0002

still money left, mo! When did I last
eat this much meat, mo...

Parvi's celebration won't stop until
our stomachs burst, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000058_04_msg0004

super-fluffy bed and sleep, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000058_04_msg0005
rows.name:

first time I've ever lived it up, mo!!

rows.label: tlk70000058_04_msg0006

But... what else do you do to live it
up besides eating meat, mo!!?
